title: Hound
summary: HOUND, noun [Latin canis.] A generic name of the dog; but in English it is confined to a particular breed or variety, used in the chase. It has long, smooth, pendulous ears. HOUND, verb transitive To

inlines.v: HOUND, noun [Latin canis.] A generic name of the dog; but in English it is confined to a particular breed or variety, used in the chase. It has long, smooth, pendulous ears. HOUND, verb transitive To set on the chase. 1. To hunt; to chase.
